subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core or plugin contract with what security and fallback policy?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, storage/retention limits, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class chat video input
options.body: Define a narrow WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits, then land or replace an implementation against that design.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding only
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the supported video.description tool-style path instead.

options.title: Narrow to provider-specific plugins first
options.body: Let providers prove native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class chat video input
recommendation.body: Define a narrow WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits, then land or replace an implementation against that design.
